verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-catalog aggregator for agents and developers. A merchant opt-in or onboarding path is a fair question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. However, every documented path (API keys, SDK, CLI, MCP, UCP, MPP payments, affiliate payouts) serves developers and agents consuming the catalog. Nothing describes a merchant enabling a setting, signing an agreement, or publishing an endpoint to receive agent traffic.
